scene_purpose: Stage the First Command Warden as the major Ancient authority confrontation of Chapter 3; preserve the locked activate-assess-reject-battle-shutdown sequence; deliver PREVIOUS ERROR and LAST SENTINEL CONFIRMED from the Warden itself; then, only after the Warden is fully inert, let Cyanis's Card stabilize into persistent deep Ruby without resolving Prime, Might, bearer, or Last Sentinel identity.
canon_override_note: Where runtime brain identity fields conflict with current whole-project canon, current canon controls. In particular Cyanis is Crest Knight / Crest Magus, Nimera is Cardweaver / Sixfold Knight, and stale brain Prime/Face/subclass labels must not enter dialogue or interpretation.
hard_outcomes: The large Diysean First Command Warden activates after the party enters the protected chamber.
The Warden visibly assesses the whole party through ancient magical craft before combat.
The assessment result is unacceptable or insufficient under an unknown old condition.
The Warden attacks and the party defeats it in a one-HP-bar story boss encounter under encounter authority.
During shutdown, while still barely active, the Warden communicates PREVIOUS ERROR.
The Warden then communicates LAST SENTINEL CONFIRMED as its final message.
Immediately after LAST SENTINEL CONFIRMED, the Warden becomes completely inert.
Only after the Warden is fully inert does Cyanis's Card reorganize from prior unstable green-and-gold behavior into a persistent stable deep Ruby state.
No Prime manifestation, recovery, summon, voice, figure, or new Card gameplay ability occurs.
The inner way becomes physically passable after the guardian is no longer maintaining the closure.
Beat 12 begins in the Ancient sealwright chamber; Beat 11 does not introduce a new map or route clue.
reveal_firewall: Do not identify what PREVIOUS ERROR refers to.
Do not establish whether LAST SENTINEL refers to Cyanis, the Card, a title, rank, guardian, or another designation.
Do not classify the Card as Prime.
Do not identify the Card with Might.
Do not confirm Cyanis as bearer or owner.
Do not mark the Card Recovered or Awakened.
Do not identify the recent reader or Calder's hidden role.
Do not reveal the Beat-12 seal-copying practitioner or mechanism.
Do not use the Ruby Card as a key to open the inner way.
Do not reveal Cresthaven or any new north-route evidence.
presentation_guardrails: The Warden is a physical magical construct, not a talking villain or digital security system.
Its assessment may use light, seal marks, ward-rings, carved apertures, gemstones, inlaid lenses, or similar ancient craft; no UI or terminal language.
PREVIOUS ERROR and LAST SENTINEL CONFIRMED must come from the Warden itself during shutdown, through fantasy-appropriate body/ward inscription or resonant magical communication.
Do not prescribe which party member must explain the Warden, translate every visual, or verbalize the reveal firewall.
Keep post-fight dialogue short; confusion and silence are valid.
